notes: The front page. Runs from the document title line through the (54) title block, following the reference run, where the invention title printed on the front page sits inside Bibliographic Data rather than in a section of its own. Lines 33 to 36 carry the two IPC codes and line 39 the page counts; these are printed field labels, not [00NN] paragraphs, which is why the markers on this page are ST.9 field codes.

contains_procedure is false although the abstract does recite the three purification steps. The recitation is a strict compression of claim 1 and of [0013] to [0016], both of which are given to A2 in their own sections, and giving A2 the abstract as well would produce a third near-identical set of records for one method. The reference run made the same call on the same grounds. Nothing is lost: A1 runs over the abstract regardless, so the compounds and the 1327 ppm to below 100 ppm figure are captured, and the same figure is printed again at [0026].

heading_text_zh: 权　利　要　求　书
notes: Three claims, one independent. Claim 1 recites the whole method as three numbered steps and then fixes the parameters that the description offers as optional: the four solvent choices, 20% to 40% water, 30 to 60 degrees C, a 0.2 h to 1 h hold, and activated carbon or diatomaceous earth. Claims 2 and 3 add the hydrochloric acid and the stirring speed and introduce no new step, so estimated_steps is 3, not 5. Every step is a purification operation rather than a bond-forming one, so A2 should mark them non_synthetic. Claim 1's solvent list is joined by the enumeration comma throughout and so does not say whether the aqueous solution is any one of the four or all four mixed together; the vision pass recorded that ambiguity and it must not be resolved here.

One paragraph, [0001]. Includes the p03 page comment and the invention title repeated at the head of the description, which is where the reference run puts the repeated title as well. Note that [0001] describes the invention as a method for reducing the level of impurities, without naming cyanide; the impurity is first named at [0011].

contains_procedure is TRUE here, which is the opposite call to the one the previous patent's background needed, and the reason is that this background does not cite other people's work at all. It characterises tembotrione ([0002] to [0007]: activity, CAS 335104-84-2, C17H16ClF3O6S, 440.88, solubilities, melting point 123 C, and the structure drawn at [0008]), then [0009] states in one sentence how tembotrione IS prepared, naming every reagent and both intermediates, and [0010] draws that route. Five steps are expected: three from the prose of [0009] (acid to acyl chloride with thionyl chloride, acyl chloride plus cyclohexanedione to the enol ester, then acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement to tembotrione) and two from the two arrows actually drawn at [0010], which collapse the first two prose stages onto one arrow. Per A2 rule 5d these are an overview: no charges, no conditions, no yields, so expect no_conditions on every record, and per rule 5f the prose steps and the drawn arrows must be kept apart by step_label rather than merged. Section type stays background per rule 11: the type is about where the block sits, not about whether chemistry can be extracted from it. One thing this section does NOT establish: whether [0009] is prior art or the invention's own route. The invention is a purification, so this synthesis is neither improved nor criticised, and [0011] treats its output as the problem to be solved. The vision pass read [0010] as prior_art on that basis; the same route redrawn at [0031] inside the embodiments was read as invention_route by a different page's pass. That disagreement is real and is recorded rather than resolved.

[0012] states the object, [0013] to [0016] the three-step method, and [0017] to [0025] nine 进一步地 (further) paragraphs narrowing each parameter. estimated_steps is 4 rather than 3 because [0021] adds an operation the three numbered steps do not contain: an organic-solvent extraction and distillation between step 2 and step 3. It is optional and it is the only step in the document that no example performs, so A2 may reasonably decline to emit it; if A2 emits 3, that is the expected disagreement and it should say so in notes rather than the count being taken as a recall miss. Two defects in this section that must be recorded and not tidied: [0024] repeats the operative clause of [0023] almost word for word, adding nothing, and [0021] is missing a verb before 入含水溶液, so the phrase cannot be read with confidence. Both are the patent's own and are printed as such.

[0026] alone, split out of 发明内容 with no heading of its own, the same way the reference run splits its beneficial-effects paragraph. It claims advantages and no technical solution: a large reduction in cyanide impurity content, higher purity, and the 1327 ppm to below 100 ppm figure, which is the abstract's closing sentence repeated. Two things to record rather than fix. It prints 磺酮 twice where the rest of the document prints 环磺酮, dropping the leading character, the same slip the abstract makes. And it credits the Ames test with the ppm figures; an Ames assay reports mutagenicity, not a cyanide concentration, so the sentence attributes to it a measurement it does not make. Neither is corrected here.

The 具体实施方式 heading, the [0027] boilerplate, and then the block the whole rest of the document depends on: [0028] 合成方案包括以下内容, the [0029] procedure, [0030], the scheme drawn at [0031], and [0032]. This is how the crude tembotrione that every example purifies is made, so it is a procedure section, not part of the summary. Typed experimental_intermediate rather than experimental_example on the ground that the compound it prepares is this patent's substrate rather than its product: the invention is the purification, and [0029] produces the red-brown solid that Examples 1 to 5 then take 5 g of. Calling tembotrione an intermediate is uncomfortable, since it is a final active ingredient in its own right, and the alternative reading (experimental_example, with the examples as its workup) is defensible; the choice is recorded here rather than left implicit. estimated_steps is 4: two from the prose of [0029], whose second charge is one-pot (1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin go in together at 40 C for 6 h, so enol ester formation and rearrangement occur without a workup between them), plus two from the two arrows drawn at [0031]. [0029] carries not one quantity, so expect scale not_specified throughout. Two contradictions to flag and not reconcile: [0029] charges thionyl chloride onto a material it names as the benzoyl CHLORIDE and then strips the excess, which is the operation one performs on the acid, and [0009] says the acid is what reacts with thionyl chloride; and the scheme at [0031] is drawn starting from the free acid, disagreeing with the prose on this same point. The vision pass read [0031] as the invention's route because it sits in the embodiments region and is announced by [0030]; the same route drawn at [0010] was read as prior art. Both readings are on record.

The variable under test is the adsorbent hold time and the dissolution temperature. Six batches, numbered 1 to 6 in the patent's own 实验批次 column, all starting from 1327 ppm cyanide. The procedures are NOT in the prose: [0034] is a one-line lead-in and every procedure lives inside the 处理方法 cell of the table, which is a page image with no text layer, so all six came from the vision pass. Batch 3 is the only one with an extra operation, 10 g of fresh 20% aqueous methanol added after the hot filtration. Per A0 rule 10 this is experimental and not assay_data, because each row carries a full procedure and not merely a value. The table runs across the p05/p06 boundary and its last row is cut mid-cell twice by the page break, so [0035], [0036] and [0037] are three printed fragments of one table; A2 must read them as six batches, not as three tables. Every row's fifth column disagrees arithmetically with the two ppm columns beside it, and batch 3 breaks monotonicity outright (more residual cyanide than batch 4, 92 against 88, yet a much lower stated reduction, 74% against 89%). Record the printed values and flag; do not recompute a cell.

The variable under test is the aqueous solvent: methanol, ethanol, acetonitrile, dimethylformamide, all at 20% water, all starting from 1125 ppm. Four batches, numbered 7 to 10, procedures again only inside the table image. The four solvents are exactly the four claim 1 lists, which makes this the section that supports the claim's solvent list. [0040] and [0041] are two printed fragments of one table, batch 10 being split across the page break. Batch 7's reduction cell prints a bare 97 with no percent sign where the other three print one, and three of the four reduction values do not follow from their own ppm pair. Note also that the first column header on this page prints 试验批次, where Example 1's table on p05 prints 实验批次: two different characters for the same column across two tables of one document, verified at 900 dpi on both pages. Recorded, not normalised.

The variable under test is the water content of the aqueous methanol: 20%, 30%, 40%, all starting from 1257 ppm. Three batches, numbered 11 to 13, procedures inside the table image only. This is the section that supports claim 1's 20% to 40% range, and the best result is at 40% (12 ppm), the top of the claimed range rather than the middle. Batch 11 alone carries an extra operation, methanol stripped off and 10 g of fresh water added, which is not a water-content variation at all and makes batch 11 not strictly comparable with 12 and 13; record it and do not smooth it over. [0044] and [0045] are two printed fragments of one table, batch 13 split across the page break, so its 处理方法 cell begins on p08 and finishes on p08 in a second fragment. All three reduction percentages disagree with their own ppm pair.

The variable under test is the adsorbent: activated carbon against diatomaceous earth, both starting from 1029 ppm. Two batches, numbered 14 and 15, procedures inside the table image only. This is the section that supports claim 1's choice of adsorbent. The two batches differ in the solvent as well as the adsorbent (20% aqueous methanol for 14, 20% aqueous ethanol for 15), so the comparison is not clean and the section does not in fact isolate the adsorbent; that is worth recording as a defect in the experimental design rather than as an extraction problem. Batch 14's reduction cell prints a bare 97 with no percent sign. The table is announced at [0047] on p08 but printed at [0048] on p09.

The variable under test is pH: 2, 3, 4 and 5, all starting from 1238 ppm. Four batches, numbered 16 to 19. This is the only example whose procedure is printed as prose rather than inside the table: [0050] gives it once and the table at [0051] then varies only the pH, so all four batches share one procedure and A2 should mark conditions_inherited accordingly. The table has no caption, unlike the other four, so its identity rests on position alone. Two findings. The prose lists the pH values ascending as 2、3、4、5 while the table lists them descending 5, 4, 3, 2; the count matches, only the order differs. And batches 18 and 19 print the same residual (25 ppm) and the same reduction (99%) at pH 3 and pH 2, so the patent's own data says pH 2 buys nothing measurable over pH 3, while [0016] and claim 1 both specify below 3. Record both; resolve neither. This is also the only table whose fourth column is headed 析晶后 (after crystallisation) rather than 处理后 (after treatment).

The only example in the document that carries quantities, and therefore the only one on which any arithmetic can be checked at all: 231.9 g of the benzoyl chloride, 1 L of 1,2-dichloroethane, 237.9 g of thionyl chloride, 500 ml of fresh 1,2-dichloroethane, 200 g of triethylamine, 92 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione, 0.5 g of acetone cyanohydrin, 5 g of activated carbon, giving 262.1 g of tembotrione at 95% content. Three steps: the thionyl chloride stage at 15 C then 75 C for 3 h, the one-pot dione plus acetone cyanohydrin stage at 40 C for 6 h, and then the purification, which is the invention, run at 40% aqueous methanol and pH 2. It is a scale-up of [0029] with the purification of Examples 1 to 5 appended, and it is the one place the synthesis and the purification appear as a single continuous operation. estimated_steps is 3 rather than 4 because the dione and the acetone cyanohydrin are charged together with no workup between, which A2 rule 5 makes one one-pot record. The [0054] and [0055] NMR is one characterisation datum split across a paragraph marker, and it belongs to the product of this section. Three things to flag: the stirring speed is printed as 280 转/h against claim 3's 150 to 200 转, so the one worked example falls outside its own claim; the pressure unit is printed mP where MPa is plainly meant; and the section again charges thionyl chloride onto a material named as the acid chloride.

[0056], the standard CNIPA closing paragraph reserving equivalents and modifications within the scope of the invention. No chemistry, no compound, no number. Typed other because none of the closed list fits a legal boilerplate paragraph; it is given a section of its own rather than folded into Example 6, so that no reaction record can pick up its lines as procedure text.
